spec_version: RAG guide 1.1.1 plus evidence-ledger, semantic-assurance, and literature-entailment methods v1

requirements.claim: The generated Lean ledger contains exactly the reported number of evidence-required sentences.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: Markdown sentence segmentation rules in generate_evidence_coverage.py are the accepted inventory boundary
out_of_scope: Linguistic optimality of Japanese sentence segmentation

requirements.claim: Every sentence counted as covered has at least one trusted primary source in the encoded ledger.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: Source trust classification is accepted as the policy definition of trusted primary
out_of_scope: Semantic entailment from a source to the full Japanese sentence

requirements.claim: The reported uncovered sentence IDs are exactly the required rows without an eligible primary source mapping.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: evidence_required values are the accepted classification output
out_of_scope: Human adjudication of borderline normative statements

requirements.claim: Coverage numerator, denominator, and rounded basis-point percentages agree with the Lean ledger.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: Percentage display uses rounded basis points
out_of_scope: Statistical confidence intervals for coverage classification

requirements.claim: Every concrete technology row has a trusted primary source and is represented in the Lean ledger.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: The curated list defines the requested concrete-technology scope
out_of_scope: Exhaustiveness over every named implementation product in the guide

requirements.claim: Fourteen core techniques satisfy distinct mechanism and pipeline-role contracts rather than broad sparse/dense category labels.
requirements.proof_status: Lean proves ledger sourcing; Quint separately checks behavior contracts
assumptions: Quint state fields adequately abstract each listed mechanism

requirements.claim: Coverage is not reported as 100 percent while uncovered required sentences remain.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: The current generated ledger is the accepted snapshot of the pinned guide
out_of_scope: Future guide revisions before ledger regeneration

requirements.claim: For every controlled single-technique formalization, Lean computes whether all guide atoms are included in the curated primary-source contract atoms.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked with decide; no extra axioms
assumptions: The curated source contracts and controlled atom patterns are the accepted finite formalization

requirements.claim: Every material detail of a Japanese guide sentence is automatically and meaning-preservingly derived from its primary source.
requirements.proof_status: not established; atom projection is proved but natural-language formalization adequacy is not kernel-certified

requirements.source: Robertson and Zaragoza BM25 primary source; Cormack et al. RRF primary source
requirements.claim: The symbolic BM25 and RRF formula models are inhabited and satisfy their stated structural properties.
requirements.proof_status: kernel checked; #print axioms reports no dependencies
assumptions: Natural numbers and symbolic fractions are the accepted formula-structure abstraction

requirements.claim: Primary-source empirical results and hosted-service behavior are independently established as true.
requirements.proof_status: not established; source statements are not introduced as Lean axioms
out_of_scope: Authenticated runtime probes for every product/version/region

requirements.claim: For every sentence row reported as MODEL_PROVED, the formalized primary-source summary facts entail the decomposed positive guide formula under every valuation.
requirements.proof_status: 446 sentence-specific theorems and the derivation soundness theorem are kernel checked; all #print axioms reports are empty
assumptions: The inspected primary-source controlled projection and guide-sentence logical decomposition are accepted as the finite formal model
Source summaries are conditional premises and do not assert external truth
out_of_scope: Claim-polarity review for 178 paper and primary-page term projections
